business_summary: C.S. Lumber Co., Inc engages in pre-cut lumber processing, construction contracting, and real estate leasing businesses. The company operates through Pre-Cut Business, Construction Contract Business, Real Estate Leasing, and Other segments. It manufactures panels for construction methods, sell products, and undertakes construction works; undertakes construction of wooden detached houses and general wooden buildings; leases and manages commercial and residential properties; develop and sell detached houses; and sells real estate properties. C.S. Lumber Co., Inc was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.
